The '''Champions' Hall''' is the officer's barracks for the [[Alliance]] in [[Stormwind]]. It is located in the south of the Old Town. 

The Horde counterpart of the Champion's Hall is the [[Hall of Legends]] in Orgrimmar.

==Trivia==
Several of the humans within the "Champions' Hall" in the Stormwind city barracks are named after the major characters from the [[wikipedia:Stargate|Stargate series]].
